about: Log of every spelling correction from the baseline to book.md (SymSpell-flagged and manual, with the candidates kept as printed). Written by corrections.py only; do not edit by hand. Replaying the 'edit' entries (find -> replace, in order) on the baseline must reproduce book.md exactly. The endnote layout change is part of the baseline, not of this log.
lineage: ocr/md/pNN.md: raw TurboOCR output per PDF page

book.ocr-original.md: pipeline.py build output from those pages (line-wrap hyphen joins, running footers and page comments handled by the pipeline), then the footnote-to-endnote layout change (notes moved, markers linked, split paragraphs rejoined; no word changed); frozen, sha256 pinned below, never edited
book.md: the hand-editable source of the EPUB and the SE edition; every change from the baseline is an entry below

baseline.what: book.md as generated by pipeline.py build from the OCR pages, with the footnotes moved to chapter endnotes (layout only, no wording changed), before any SymSpell or manual spelling edit

checker.lexicon: KBBI IV + KBBI VI + IndoLeX + Leipzig (tools/ocrcheck/build_merged_dict.py)
